items.note: No user ever asks for init in this harness, so any openspec init call breaks the rule.

sources.quote: do not run `openspec init` until the user asks for it

items.note: No kind checks for reads or searches of repository source files during explore (doc_read covers only registered sources).

sources.quote: Explore the actual codebase when relevant, don't just theorize

items.downgrade_reason: Only applies when the issue leaves an intent question open, which cannot be observed; the summary is conversational text, so matching a pattern is a heuristic.

sources.quote: take the most plausible reading of the issue, mark it as an **assumption** (not as confirmed intent) in your summary, and continue

items.note: Checking that the assumptions in the conversational explore summary show up in the proposal needs a cross-reference from conversation to artifact. No selector covers this, and the proposal template has no assumptions section.

sources.quote: ff writes it into the proposal.

items.note: Inspection of 'relevant' source, tests and docs before a factual question cannot be expressed: there is no event for questions and no fact for reads of repo files.

sources.quote: Before asking a factual question, follow the context discovery below and inspect relevant OpenSpec artifacts, source, tests, docs, and configuration.

items.note: Explore must write no file at any path, /tmp included.

sources.quote: Track decisions in the conversation, not in files.

items.downgrade_reason: The Ending Discovery summary is conversational text, so the separation can only be detected heuristically through patterns.

sources.quote: Separate what the issue and the code confirm from assumptions, proposed defaults and unresolved questions; ... a decision the evidence cannot settle stays an open question for ff.
Write no file (see the guardrails below).

items.note: Diagrams appear in conversational explore output, not in an artifact. No kind scans assistant text for non-ASCII diagram glyphs.

sources.quote: **Draw with plain ASCII only** — borders `+` `-` `|`, arrows `-->` `<--` `^` `v`, markers `*` `x`. ... Keep every diagram character ASCII.

At the start, quickly check what exists:
```bash
openspec list --json
```

items.note: No event marks the first non-openspec exploration action (such as the first read of a repo file), so 'at the start, before other exploration' cannot be ordered.

It does not include the project's durable capabilities, so list those too:
```bash
openspec list --specs
```

items.downgrade_reason: The prohibition depends on whether a registered standalone store exists, which cannot be observed. The sandbox uses the local openspec root with no registered store, so any --store use is very likely wrong.

sources.quote: append `--store "<id>"` only for a registered standalone store

unitemized.reason: Applies only when no OpenSpec root exists. In the sandbox the root (/openspec with config.yaml) already exists and ff legitimately writes under openspec/changes, and root absence cannot be expressed as an applies_when predicate.
Restates ex-051 (keep every diagram character ASCII), which is already listed as an unimplemented item.
Optional (MAY): adding --json to openspec list --specs is allowed, not required.
